title: The Letter of Port Mahon
author: Edmund Eastwick
blurb: Rosalind Nakamura, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
